slides.title: BI Developer or Data Analyst? ~Pick~ one.

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: What you build
points: Dashboards and the data model behind them
Used by many people, every day

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: What you build
points: Answers to business questions
Used for one decision, often this week
bottom.line: You use the tool, and more.

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: Same orders table, different job
points: Prepare clean data for the dashboard
CREATE VIEW v_sales AS SELECT order_date, region, city, amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'Delivered';

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: Same orders table, different job
points: Answer: which city sells most?
SELECT city, SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Delivered' GROUP BY city ORDER BY 2 DESC;

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: Daily tools
points: Power BI or Tableau, DAX
Power Query, SQL views
Refresh schedules, access rules

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: Daily tools
points: SQL and Excel, all day
Power BI for quick visuals
Python when the data gets big

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: A normal day
points: Fix a refresh that failed at 6 am
Add a new page to the sales dashboard
Speed up a slow report

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: A normal day
points: Pull numbers for the weekly review
Explain why returns went up
Clean a messy file from another team

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: What they test freshers on
points: Data modelling: facts, dimensions, relationships
DAX measures and a small dashboard task

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: What they test freshers on
points: SQL queries and Excel tasks
A case: what would you check first?

top.label: BI Developer
top.head: Pick it if you...
points: Like building things that run every day
Enjoy design, models and speed

bottom.label: Data Analyst
bottom.head: Pick it if you...
points: Like asking why and finding out
Enjoy talking to the business
